skill.summary: Installs and uses Docker reliably with official docs. Use when installing Docker (Desktop or Engine), building or running containers, writing Dockerfiles, us...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of docker-skill.
- Provides robust installation and usage guidance for Docker across macOS, Linux, and Windows.
- Directs all recommendations to official Docker documentation and canonical URLs.
- Covers Docker Desktop, Docker Engine, CLI commands, Dockerfiles, Compose workflows, and troubleshooting connectivity.
- Includes reliable install steps, quick reference commands, and sample workflows for building and running containers.
